text: Visitors have raised concerns about the timed ticketing system, with several reporting frustration at being turned away without a reservation and a perceived lack of flexibility from staff. Accessibility issues were noted, particularly poor signage for handicap parking and limited shuttle service for those needing assistance from the parking area to the entrance. Some reviews criticized the extensive use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. On the positive side, many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging, though some felt the displays relied heavily on replicas. Overall, the average rating remains high, but attention to visitor flow, accessibility, and exhibit presentation could improve satisfaction.

windows.7: Visitors in the past week have expressed frustration with the timed entry system, particularly the strict enforcement of reservations without flexibility, which led to at least two guests being turned away despite low crowd levels. Some reviewers also noted issues with staff attitude, describing a lack of accommodation or sympathy when concerns were raised. There were mixed comments about the interactive exhibits, with a few visitors mentioning them but not consistently praising or criticizing. A couple of reviews touched on the use of AI in the exhibits, with some criticism noted. Overall, the average rating was moderate, reflecting these concerns alongside other visitor experiences.

windows.90: Over the last 90 days, several visitors expressed frustration with the timed ticketing system, noting a lack of flexibility or accommodation when arriving without a reservation. Accessibility was also a concern, with unclear signage for handicap parking and limited shuttle service for those needing assistance from the parking area to the entrance. Some reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. On the positive side, many visitors appreciated the building’s architecture and found the exhibits informative and engaging, especially for families and a range of age groups. Staff interactions received mixed feedback, with some visitors feeling the service was unsympathetic in certain situations.
